subject: Request: Partner trial extension and co-funding approval — CloudLayer Marketplace
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@cloudlayer.io>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: matt.rios@cloudlayer.io, finance@cloudlayer.io
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — 6 week trial extension + co-funded credit for SI pilot

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the CloudLayer team is excited about Redwood for our managed inference use case. We have a proof-of-concept scheduled with one of our retail customers (PilotCo) and they asked for a slightly longer evaluation window to validate peak-hour load and integration with their data pipeline.

Request: could CloudLayer get a 6-week extension to the trial window, and would Redwood consider a partner co-funding arrangement for up to $12,000 in promotional credits applied to the PilotCo workload? The ask is conditional on PilotCo signing the attached simple SOW and committing to a joint case study if the pilot completes successfully.

Why this matters: PilotCo is likely to convert to a paid tier if we can show cost/latency improvements at scale; the SI will use Redwood as the inference backend in their managed offering. We can provide a short mutual action plan and host a technical readout.

Attachments: cloudlayer_scope.pdf (SOW draft)

Please advise the approval path and any paperwork your procurement/legal needs. Happy to jump on a quick call today.

Best,
Elena Park
Partnerships Lead, CloudLayer
elena@cloudlayer.io
+1 415 555 0162

---
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request — 6 week trial extension + co-funded credit for SI pilot

Vanessa / Marcus — forwarding CloudLayer's ask. Short summary:
- Extension: +6 weeks for the PilotCo evaluation window
- Credits: partner asks Redwood to co-fund up to $12k in promotional credits applied to the PilotCo account; they will onboard PilotCo as an SI-led PoV and provide a joint case study if it converts.

Questions for approvals:
1) Does Redwood have flexibility to extend trial window for partner-sourced pilots without opening the general marketplace to extended trials?
2) Are we comfortable approving a $12k co-fund/credit against the partner-managed account? If yes, any ledger/tracking preferences (promo code vs direct allocation)?
3) Any required legal procurement docs (we may need a simple addendum and partner agreement sign-off).

I've attached the partner_credit_request_form.pdf with basic fields filled. Proposed vote: approve up to $12k conditional on signed SOW + mutual action plan + customer contact for case study. If we greenlight, next step is DocuSign for a trial extension addendum and finance ticket to allocate credits.

Happy to talk through; I can loop in Legal if needed.

— Alex
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request — 6 week trial extension + co-funded credit for SI pilot

Thanks Alex. I reviewed the SOW and the partner form. I approve the co-funding request with these guardrails:
- Cap at $12,000 total in Redwood promotional credits tied to the PilotCo account (no cash payout).
- Credits to be released in two tranches: $6k at trial extension activation, $6k at successful completion of the 6-week milestone and joint case study sign-off.
- Partner (CloudLayer) must provide the signed SOW and a named PilotCo technical contact before we allocate credits.
- Trial extension addendum to be executed via DocuSign; Legal to review the addendum language for the case study clause.

Operational notes for Marcus / Finance: please create an internal ledger code for CL-2026-129 and set the promo code to expire 90 days after completion to prevent unintended reuse. Finance — please confirm whether we should issue a marketplace voucher or apply credits directly to the PilotCo account.

Alex, once Legal gives the greenlight I'll route the DocuSign link to Elena and finance for processing.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: partner_credit_request_form.pdf
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@cloudlayer.io>, Matt Rios <matt.rios@cloudlayer.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — 6 week trial extension + co-funded credit for SI pilot

Elena / Matt — good news: Redwood has provisionally approved the partner co-fund for PilotCo under the conditions below. High-level next steps:

What we approved:
- Redwood will allocate up to $12,000 in promotional credits, released in two tranches ($6k on activation, $6k on milestone completion).
- Trial window extended by 6 weeks from activation date.

Conditions (please confirm):
1) Signed SOW (we received your draft; please return with PilotCo signature).
2) Named PilotCo technical contact and target milestone dates in the mutual action plan.
3) Agreement to the joint case study, with Redwood review rights on technical content.

Operational items we're doing on our side:
- Legal will issue a one-page trial addendum via DocuSign (link will be shared once reviewed).
- Finance (Marcus) will create ledger CL-2026-129 and provision the promo code.
- Marketing: I'll schedule a 30-min onboarding readout with CloudLayer + PilotCo once the addendum is signed.

Elena — can you confirm PilotCo's signed SOW and the named technical lead by EOD tomorrow? If yes, we'll get the DocuSign out the same day.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: docusign_cl_trial_agreement.link
